notes.title: First Major Update
notes.content:
So with the fitfh update to our game, where major changes have been made thanks for people sending us feedback we decided to celebrate by uploading a brand new cinematic. Because everyone loves a good a cinematic (our is okeyish... :D)

Here comes our  list of updates!

New content and features
- Added tutorial for an easier introduction to game mechanic.
- Added option to turn off tooltips in the main menu.
- Added autosave to all missions.
- Added pause to enemy flood in mission one. 
- Added difficulty setting to the game.
- Added a Cinemetic. (duh!)
- Added more sound effects to enemies.

Polish
Polished melee enemy death rotation.
Polished Vector Soldiers rotation while walking in proximity to enemies.

Changes
- Added timer to allow more heal than once per mission.

Bugfixes
Fixed incorrect done UI problem
Fixed Fullscreen bug
Fixed Quality setting
Fixed mission times not saved from main menu
